summary: The DGA text input: a native input with a visible label, hint, error message and optional decorative icons. A signal-model control: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when the surrounding UI already labels the input (translated).

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Placeholder (translated); never a replacement for the label.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Help text under the input (translated), linked by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the input invalid.

inputs.name: inputMode
inputs.description: The inputmode hint for virtual keyboards.

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: The native maxlength; null or NaN means not set.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required plus a decorative asterisk on the label.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the input invalid without a message (a form field may set it).

inputs.name: leadIcon
inputs.description: Decorative icon at the start of the control.

inputs.name: trailIcon
inputs.description: Decorative icon at the end of the control.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new text on every input event (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true on the first blur.

a11y: The label is linked with for/id; hint and error are linked with aria-describedby, and an error or invalid sets aria-invalid. Without a visible label give ariaLabel. The required asterisk is aria-hidden (the native required attribute carries the state). Icons are decorative. Logical CSS mirrors the icons in RTL.
